desc: When casting an alloyblood hybrid mantra, refresh your critical attack cooldown. Your critical hits with alloyblood weaponry now add composite plasma to your opponent.
name: Plasma Refresh
reqs: 40 bld, 40 mtl, 60 med or 60 lht or 60 hvy
additional_info: Keep in mind that all of the Alloyblood weapons (Alloyblood Axe, Alloyblood Daggers, and Alloyblood Spear have the default critical attacks of their weapon types.
